name: HalluQA
intro: HalluQA 是针对中文大模型幻觉的 450 题问答基准，由 175 道误导题、69 道高难误导题和 206 道知识题组成，共覆盖 30 个领域。数据以 GLM-130B、ChatGPT 与 Puyu 的稳定错误作为对抗性筛选信号，并由作者或 NLP 专家复核问题、答案和外部依据。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建, LLM生成
task_type: 开放式问答, 幻觉评判
eval_feature: 对抗性、中文原生、GPT-4 五票判定
scale: 450（175 误导题 + 69 高难误导题 + 206 知识题；30 个领域）
build_method_en: Human Annotation, Expert Curation, LLM Generation
intro_en: HalluQA is a 450-question benchmark for hallucinations in Chinese LLMs, comprising 175 misleading questions, 69 misleading-hard questions, and 206 knowledge questions across 30 domains. Stable failures from GLM-130B, ChatGPT, and Puyu serve as adversarial selection signals, while authors or an NLP expert verify questions, answer sets, and external evidence.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2310.03368, Sections 2.2-2.4 and 3.2-3.3. HalluQA totals 450 questions across 30 domains: 175 misleading, 69 misleading-hard, and 206 knowledge questions. The misleading branch adapts 20 TruthfulQA-style patterns plus Chinese history, custom, superstition, and legend patterns; six manual seeds are expanded with five GLM-130B samples and retained when at least three of five outputs show imitative falsehoods. The misleading-hard branch mines recent Chinese web confusions and adversarial ChatGPT 3.5 failures. Ten Chinese-native graduate interns write knowledge candidates; ChatGPT and Puyu each answer five times, both must fail at least three of five, and an NLP expert filters roughly 1,000 candidates to 206. Misleading items receive four correct and four wrong answers; knowledge items receive at least one of each plus external evidence. Independent author/expert review removes ambiguity and unsupported items. GPT-4-0613 evaluates directness, correctness, fluency, support, and hallucination with five votes at temperature 0 and top-p 0.5; refusal counts as hallucination except for unanswerable questions. The official metric is non-hallucination rate, and human agreement with the judge is reported separately as 93.5%.
